title: Pictory Versus InVideo: AI Video Editing for Social Media Ads
hook: Pictory needs less input than InVideo to make a video.

narration.text: Pictory needs less input than InVideo to make a video.
Both tools help create social media ads quickly.
They convert text scripts into full videos.
They add relevant stock footage and music automatically.
Pictory excels at summarising long articles into short videos.
InVideo provides more customisation options for templates.
Its interface feels more familiar to traditional video editors.
Pictory is better for quick, automated content generation.
InVideo offers more creative control for specific ad campaigns.
For speed and simplicity, Pictory has an edge.
For custom ad design, InVideo is stronger.
Which AI video editor do you prefer? Follow for daily AI tools.

description: We compare Pictory and InVideo, two popular AI video editing tools. Discover which one is best for creating social media ads quickly and efficiently. Both convert text into video with stock media, but they have different strengths.
